description: This file defines the CreateTestDatabaseCommand class, a Symfony console command for creating and initializing a test database within the OrangeHRM system. It handles database schema management, imports dump data, and sets up fixtures, implementing core operations for test environment setup.

classes.name: CreateTestDatabaseCommand
classes.description: A Symfony console command class responsible for creating and setting up a test database, including schema creation, importing dump data, and fixtures.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets up command description and input options for database user, password, and dump options.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main execution method that drops existing test database, creates a new one, imports schema/data from dump, and generates fixtures.

methods.name: createTestDBConnection
methods.description: Creates and returns a Doctrine DBAL Connection object for the test database with provided user and password.
